name: How can I choose a reliable mold damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How can I choose a reliable mold damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a mold damage restoration company, look for certifications from reputable organizations like the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC). Ensure they are licensed, insured, and have experience with mold remediation specific to your type of property. Request detailed proposals that outline the scope of work, estimated timelines, and costs. Check customer reviews and ask for references. A transparent company will explain their process, answer your questions thoroughly, and prioritize containing the mold to prevent cross-contamination. Avoid companies that offer to simply paint over mold without proper removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a mold restoration company with IICRC certification, licensing, insurance, and relevant experience. Request detailed proposals, check references, and ensure they follow containment procedures.
